source.description:
## PROBLEM
Pi custom-footer surfaces unread xtmux messages per-pane via the pi-inbox-reply extension. Claude statusline has no equivalent — an agent-coordinator or operator working in a Claude pane cannot see at a glance whether the sibling pane has queued a message for them, and must poll manually via 'tmux-session-picker message-list --for $SID'. This is asymmetric UX.

## SUCCESS
- Claude statusline surfaces unread count for the current pane, prepended to line3.
- Empty state (0 unread) renders nothing (no line noise).
- Freshness marker for stale unacked messages (e.g. bold red '!' if oldest > 5 min).
- Zero render-time subprocess: fetched in detached refresh, cached per-pane.
- Fail-soft: TMUX absent, tmux-session-picker missing, or non-tmux invocation → no indicator, no crash.
- No regression on the existing beads-status shared cache — this is a separate per-pane cache.

## SCOPE
- .xtrm/hooks/statusline.mjs (extend refresh + render)
- .xtrm/hooks/statusline.test.mjs (fixture unread cache, verify prepend + fail-soft paths)
- Optional new helper .xtrm/hooks/unread-cache.mjs if the surface warrants extraction

## CONSTRAINTS
- Per-pane cache path: <CACHE_DIR>/xtrm-sl-unread-<paneHash>.json where paneHash = md5(TMUX_PANE).slice(0,8).
- Schema: { ts, count, oldestUnackedAtMs }.
- TTL: 5s (align with existing statusline caches).
- Query: tmux-session-picker unread-count --for $SID --pane $TMUX_PANE where $SID = 'tmux display-message -p #{session_id}'.
- Runtime for tmux-session-picker call: warm ~110ms (measured 2026-07-13 on this machine — under detached refresh budget).
- Render format: '✉ N · <rest of line3>'. Bold red '!' marker if age > 5 min.
- No changes to Pi custom-footer or shared beads cache module.

## VALIDATION
- Test: fixture cache with count=3, oldest recent → line3 starts with '✉ 3 ·'.
- Test: fixture cache with count=0 → no marker.
- Test: TMUX env absent → no indicator, no throw.
- Test: tmux-session-picker missing (PATH stripped) → no indicator, no throw.
- Manual smoke: send a test message via message-send to current session, wait 5s, see counter increment.

## OUTPUT
Extended statusline + tests + optional helper module.

## NOTES
- Discovered during xtrm-77t9q.3 release-cut discussion after operator noticed Pi has this indicator via custom-footer but Claude does not (2026-07-13).
- Defer to after xtrm-77t9q.3 (release cut) to keep MVP scope tight.
source.title: Unread-message indicator in Claude statusline (parity with Pi custom-footer)
